primary:
Create ONE finished professional horizontal logo for the virtual cinema app "NanCine". Use-case: logo-design. The attached images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: classic movie theater, warm ivory ticket paper, burgundy velvet, restrained golden marquee accents. Do not reproduce the app interface.

Design a distinctive, beautifully resolved, flat vector-style identity, a contemporary interpretation of classic cinema signage. At LEFT a compact emblem: a burgundy arched theater portal with a single substantial antique-gold outline, containing a bold custom ivory capital N whose diagonal subtly incorporates a rightward play gesture through negative space. Minimal, balanced geometric silhouette; no tiny perforations, no lightbulbs, no ornamental clutter. At RIGHT the exact word "NanCine", one word, capital N and capital C, all other letters lowercase. A bold condensed custom sans-serif wordmark with confident vintage cinema character, refined optical spacing, coherent rounded internal corners. "Nan" in deep burgundy #890F2B and "Cine" in antique gold #C99A3D. Make this genuinely polished as a real brand mark, with a unique N emblem and clean, memorable typography. Match the sophistication and warm theatrical mood of the supplied references.

The logo should occupy most of a wide horizontal canvas, centered, with modest clear space on all sides. Flat solid inks, razor-sharp clean edges. No gradients, no shadows, no mockups, no texture, no scenery, no presentation board, no labels, no tagline, no extra text. TRUE transparent background. Output only the finished horizontal emblem + NanCine wordmark.

variants.prompt: Use-case logo-design. Derive the VERTICAL STACKED lockup of the exact attached NanCine logo. The attached image is the approved DESIGN REFERENCE, not a presentation to reproduce. Preserve the distinctive burgundy arched cinema emblem with antique-gold rim and ivory N/play glyph EXACTLY, its silhouette, internal glyph geometry, and palette. Put that emblem centered ABOVE the exact "NanCine" wordmark, one word capital N and C, matching the original bold condensed letterforms, Nan burgundy and Cine gold. The emblem should be about 55% the width of the wordmark. Balanced generous but not excessive spacing. Square canvas with modest outside clear space. Flat crisp professional brand artwork. No mockups, labels, taglines, scenery or extra text. True transparent background. ONE stacked logo only.

Use-case logo-design. Create the square app launcher icon derived from the attached approved NanCine logo. Preserve EXACTLY the emblem: burgundy arched cinema portal with antique-gold thick border, ivory stylized N and burgundy negative-space rightward play triangle. Use ONLY this emblem, no wordmark or other text. Center the emblem within a full-bleed, perfectly square, deep burgundy #650D24 SOLID background. The emblem occupies 58 percent of the canvas width and 62 percent of the height, leaving generous safe padding for circular and rounded-square operating system masks. Keep the overall composition symmetric, exceptionally crisp and readable, premium classic cinema. Flat colors, no texture, no glow, no bevel, no drop shadows, no 3D. Do not pre-round the canvas corners. No device mockup. Output a single actual app icon asset, square, opaque.

Use-case logo-design. Extract and faithfully reproduce ONLY the arched N/play EMBLEM from the attached NanCine logo. Preserve EXACTLY the proportions, burgundy theater-portal shape, substantial antique-gold arch border, warm ivory N glyph and burgundy rightward play triangle negative-space detail. Remove all NanCine wordmark text. Center the emblem, occupying 83 percent of a square canvas, with equal clear space and full sharp edges. The external background must be TRUE TRANSPARENT. No new elements, no words, no labels, no extra ornament, no mockup, no shadows or glow. This is the standalone logo symbol for mobile headers and compact desktop navigation. One symbol only.

monochrome: Create a pristine ONE-COLOR IVORY version of this attached NanCine logo on a completely solid deep burgundy #650D24 opaque background, wide horizontal composition. Use the attached original colored logo as the reference for the exact custom letterforms, spacing and proportions. Wordmark reads exactly NanCine, capital N and C, all other letters lowercase. Preserve the arched cinema portal emblem at left with its N and rightward play cutout. Render the arch border, N glyph and every letter entirely in flat warm ivory #F3E5C1, with all negative spaces burgundy. Redraw as mathematically clean, crisp flat vector-style geometry, pristine smooth contours. Extremely important: perfectly clean uninterrupted solid background and clean edges. No speckles, stray marks, splatters, distressed texture, scratches, decorative flourishes, shading, gradients, glow or bevel. No labels, extra text, mockup, or image of a board. Logo occupies 88% of canvas width, centered with comfortable clear space. Output only the one monochromatic ivory NanCine logo on a flat opaque burgundy background.
